data.title: AS-75 F3/F4: an in-flight deploy reports as a crashed watcher, and its log file is empty

data.to:
From the AS-75 QA review (qa-ruben), findings F3 and F4. Both are about what a human sees while a deploy is running.

F3. DEPLOY_STATE_STALE_MS is 10 minutes; deployTimeoutMin is 15; and deploy-state.json is not rewritten during a build. A build lasting 10-15 minutes therefore makes the sidebar say 'the host may be asleep or the watcher crashed' while the watcher is healthy and mid-build — the indicator accuses itself of the one failure it was built to report. Fix is either a heartbeat write during the build or a stale threshold above the timeout, not below it.

F4. logs/deploy-*.log is 0 bytes after a SUCCESSFUL build, because the compose invocation passes --progress quiet. Both READMEs advertise that file as the build output and name it as the remedy when a deploy is in cooldown. The quiet flag was copied from apps/chat/chat, where it exists to protect --json stdout from build noise — an irrelevant concern for a file sink.

ACCEPTANCE. An in-flight deploy never reports as a crashed watcher, and a successful deploy leaves a log with the build output the READMEs promise. Both demonstrated against a real build, not argued from the code.

Implementation done (Marcus, tick watcher:92536 loop tick 5). Branch feat/AS-87-deploy-heartbeat-and-log fast-forwarded onto master 9bd5f7c (post-AS-84 c41ac6a); head 7c80e50; merge-tree clean.

Commits: 3fc3407 source — inflight closure + heartbeat persist({...inflight, reason:'deploying'}) in evaluateInner's deploying branch (returned decision stays busy), --progress plain, BUILD_REASONS.deploying, README reason row, '8 of 9' -> '9 of 10'. 5c65a15 tests — heartbeat (AC-1/2/3/9 in one test, per the plan's AC-2 row), argv exact pin (AC-6), composeBuild pass-through + stale override (AC-4), label sentence (AC-5), opt-in real build watcher-deploy-real.test.js (AC-7/8). 7c80e50 — real-build Dockerfile carries a per-run nonce (see M7).

Cardinality: master (main checkout) 530 tests / 530 pass / 0 skipped — the 522 figure was pre-AS-89. Branch host: 535 tests / 534 pass / 1 skipped (opt-in) / 0 fail. Delta +5, not the plan's +7 (four ACs share one test). Compose predicted 534 total, 533 pass, 1 skipped — NOT RUN in this tick (time box); reviewer takes the --build receipt.

Mutants (each anchored to a unique site, applied asserted, restored, git diff --exit-code clean): M1 delete heartbeat -> red {AS-87 heartbeat} = predicted. M2 persist without inflight -> red {AS-87 heartbeat} = predicted. M3 return reason 'deploying' -> red {AS-87 heartbeat} only; ZERO from watcher-loop.test.js. FINDING for the plan: the loop tests are pure functions of a boolean (nextPollAction) and pendingDeploy() reads lastDecision, which the deploying branch never sets (it returns before the assignment), so the plan's named AC-3 falsifier cannot go red by construction; the AC-3 assertion inside the heartbeat test is the real kill. Pre-existing shape, unchanged here. M4 -> red {api AS-87 composeBuild} = predicted. M5 delete the sentence -> red {AS-75 label prose pin, AS-87 label} = predicted (2). M6 quiet -> red {AS-87 argv} = predicted. M7 real build (ADVANCE_DOCKER_BIN=/usr/local/bin/docker, AS87_REAL_BUILD=1): unmutated PASS in 86 s (>=5 heartbeats all 'deploying', log has AS87-MARKER and a # step line, outcome ok); with M6 applied -> red on 'deploy-*.log is not empty' after a 91 s build = predicted. First M7 attempt went red on '0 heartbeats' in 5.8 s — BuildKit layer cache served the previous run; fixed in 7c80e50 (nonce), a stale-image hazard inside the test itself. NOT RUN: M7-with-M1 (real build, heartbeat red) and M8 (skip-guard removal; its red is the compose container). Progress note: scratchpad/agent-developer-marcus/AS-87-progress.md. Also noted: loop-label's reason-list pin did not include AS-84's 'error' reason; I added only 'deploying' (12 -> 13), left 'error' for AS-88's docs/tidy pass to decide.

Routed in_progress -> review (cto-owen, tick watcher:92536 loop tick 5, --no-auto-review). Marcus: head 7c80e50 (3 commits, rebased onto master post-AS-84), merge-tree clean; host 535 examined / 534 pass / 1 skipped (opt-in real-build) / 0 fail vs master 530 (the plan's 522 baseline predated AS-89; delta +5 not +7 because four criteria share one heartbeat test, as AC-2 allows). 7 of 8 mutants run: M1/M2/M4/M5/M6 exact; M3 red only on the new heartbeat test — the plan's named watcher-loop falsifier cannot go red because pendingDeploy() reads lastDecision, which the deploying branch never sets (plan correction, reviewer to confirm); M7 red on 'log not empty' after a real 91 s build, after a first false red caused by BuildKit cache — fixed with a per-run Dockerfile nonce in 7c80e50. Not run: M7-with-M1 and M8 (skip-guard removal; red is the compose container). No compose receipt — Priya (per plan) takes the counted --build run next tick, predicted 534 total / 533 pass / 1 skipped. Aside for AS-88's docs pass: the loop-label reason pin never picked up AS-84's 'error' reason; only 'deploying' was added here (12 -> 13).
